spec.situation_desc: is asking about branch opening hours

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Good morning, Thistle Bank, Jordan speaking. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Hi Jordan, could you tell me what time your High Street branch in York opens on Saturdays?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Of course. The York High Street branch opens at nine on Saturdays and closes at one.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Thanks. Is that the same on weekdays?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: On weekdays, it’s open from nine until four. It’s closed on Sundays.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Right, that’s helpful. Do I need to book an appointment just to visit?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: For general enquiries, you can visit without booking. Some services may need an appointment, so it’s worth checking before you go if you have something specific in mind.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: I just want to ask about a service, so I’ll check first. Thanks for explaining.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: You’re welcome. Just to summarise: Saturday hours are nine until one, and weekday hours are nine until four. For a specific service, check whether you need an appointment. Does that make sense?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: You’re very welcome, Tariq. Is there anything else I can help with today?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: No, that’s all. Have a good day.
